description: This file defines Swagger API resource classes related to templates within the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for CRUD operations on templates.

classes.name: TemplatesApiResourcesSwagger
classes.description: Final class containing Swagger schema definitions for template API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetTemplatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for response when retrieving multiple templates.

classes.name: GetTemplatesTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for response when retrieving a single template.

classes.name: PostTemplatesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new template.

classes.name: PostTemplatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a template, containing the resource ID.

classes.name: GetTemplatesTemplateIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response when retrieving a template by ID.

classes.name: PutTemplatesTemplateIdRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating a template by ID.

classes.name: PutTemplatesTemplateIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a template, containing the resource ID.

classes.name: DeleteTemplatesTemplateIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a template, containing the resource ID.
